'''Beliyar Ramdas Bhat''' was a professor and head of the department of statistics at [[Karnatak University]] in India for more than two decades. After retiring from Karnatak University, he became a professor at the [[University of Botswana]] in Africa.<ref>Author profile from ''Stochastic Models: Analysis and Applications''.</ref> He was elected member of [[International Statistical Institute]] and the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]<ref name=ims/> and Fellow of [[Royal Statistical Society]].

Bhat obtained a M.A. degree in mathematics from [[Madras University]] in 1954, and a M.A. degree in statistics from [[Karnataka]] University,<ref name=ims>{{cite journal |title=News and Notices |journal=The Annals of Mathematical Statistics |date=1959 |volume=30 |issue=4 |pages=1279–1286 |url=http://www.jstor.org/stable/2237484 |access-date=3 March 2022 |issn=0003-4851}}</ref>  prior to working on a Ph.D. from [[University of California, Berkeley|Berkeley]] in 1961. His advisor was [[David Blackwell]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Beliyar Ramdas Bhat |url=https://statistics.berkeley.edu/people/beliyar-ramdas-bhat |work=PhD Alumni|publisher=University of California, Berkeley, Department of Statistics |access-date=3 March 2022}}</ref><ref>{{mathgenealogy|34367}}</ref> Bhat was elected member of Institute of Mathematical Statistics, and South African Statistical Association. He was the Secretary, Editor and President of Indian Society for Probability and Statistics. He was also the past President of the Section of Statistics of the [[Indian Science Congress Association]].

==Selected works==
Bhat was the author of books including:
* {{cite book |title=Modern Probability Theory: An Introductory Textbook |publisher=Wiley Eastern |location=New Delhi, India |year=1986 |isbn=0-85226-091-1 }}
* {{cite book |title=Stochastic Processes and Statistical Inference |publisher=New Age International |year=1996 |isbn=81-224-0836-2 }}
* {{cite book | title=Stochastic Models: Analysis and Applications|publisher=New Age International |year=2000 | isbn=9788122412284}}

He was the founding editor-in-chief of the ''Journal of the Indian Society for Probability and Statistics''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://isps.org.in/about/|title=Our origin|publisher=Indian Society for Probability and Statistics|access-date=2024-05-06}}</ref>
